enemy-010-spitter.note: Three idle and first two death poses share a sufficiently comparable lateral head attitude. Longitudinal rigid cranial chord includes the back edge of the head shell and the forward blue-black dome tip, excluding teeth, yellow reservoir highlights, dorsal spines and arms. Death pose2 is excluded because yaw/foreshortening is greater. Move/attack are not calibrated in this pass because their head attitude and ridge shape differ; factors stay1, not a claim of verified equal size.
